main_text.p: duobus Mosainensibus qui de hominum actionibus quæsiverant, num essent شي قضي عليهم ومضي فيهم من قدر سبق ام فيما يستقبلون quid de ipsis prædeterminatum, & jam antea decretum, an quod ipsi postea patraverint, responsum fertur, بل شي قضي عليهم Non, sed res quæ de ipsis prædeterminata fuit. Cui & addi potest ab ipso dictum السعيد من سعد في بطن امه والشقي من شقي في بطن امه Felix Sharhol, Tawale & EbnolAthir. in شقي est qui felix fuit [scil. cui prædeterminata est felicitas] in utero matris suæ; & miser qui miser fuit in utero matris suæ. Hæc atque alia ejusmodi dicta contra Motazalos afferuntur, quibus probetur illos AlKadariorum nomine à Mohammede indicatos; at è contra ut Allabarios eum hoc nomine innuisse probet AlMotarrezi hoc ipsius dictum citat, لعنت القدرية والمرجية على لسان سبعين نبيا Maledicti sunt AlKadarii & AlMorjii lingua 70. Prophetarum, in quo, quos per AlKadarios intelligerent interrogatum respondisse, قوم يزعمون ان الله قدر عليهم المعاصي وعذبهم عليها Homines qui affirment Deum decrevisse ipsis rebellionem, & ipsos ob eam punire. ح. ص lib. الرن &c. [?] Item illud AlHasani ان الله بعث محمدا الي العرب وهم قدرية مجبرة يحملون ذنوبهم على الله تعالى Deum misisse Mohammedem ad Arabes cum ipsi essent Kadarii, Iabarii, qui peccata sua in Deum conjicerent. page.notes: Arabic and Hebrew-script passages are copied from the scan as far as legible; the Arabic word forms in the notes and in the text are uncertain in places and may contain errors. The right-margin note "ح. ص lib. الرن &c." is doubtful. The Latin "Maledicti" and "Iabarii" are read as printed but are uncertain. The line "ex Al-" ends the page with a hyphen; the catchword "corano" completes it on the next page. Note placement is approximate: the first marginal note is beside the "Felix" line, the second beside the Arabic "Maledicti" line.
